architecture_preflight.interpretation: In the current AUAF forward pass, absent-modality tokens are key-padded in Transformer attention and receive zero gate weight; their learned mask-token values therefore have no path to the prediction output.

immutable_manifest.preprocessing_policy: Train-only median imputation and standardization, exactly as Stage 4.5 S0.
immutable_manifest.split_policy: Frozen Stage 4.3 participant-level split manifests; no re-splitting.
immutable_manifest.test_evaluation_policy: Best checkpoint selected by validation Macro-F1; test evaluated once after selection.

variant_definitions.AUAF: Original AUAF implementation; both gates, mask-token inputs, Transformer blocks and structured modality dropout retained.
variant_definitions.AUAF_NoContentGate: Remove the content-derived gate score; retain only the structural availability-derived gate score.
variant_definitions.AUAF_NoMaskTokens: For unavailable modalities, replace the learned mask-token vector with zeros. The mask-token parameters remain instantiated but are disconnected to preserve matched initialization. The original key-padding mask and availability-aware gate remain unchanged.
variant_definitions.AUAF_NoModalityDropout: Disable structured modality dropout during training; retain the original inference-time availability mask, Transformer and both gates.
variant_definitions.AUAF_NoStructuralGate: Remove the structural availability-derived gate score; retain only the content-derived gate score, with unavailable modalities still masked before softmax.
variant_definitions.AUAF_NoTransformer: Bypass all cross-modal Transformer blocks and the CLS aggregation branch; classify the availability-weighted modality-token summary directly.
variant_definitions.AUAF_UniformGate: Remove both learned gate scores and assign equal weights across the modalities available for each participant.
